definitions.explanation: A serious misfortune or disaster, often with a sense of being brought by fate or forces beyond human control. More literary and weighty than everyday words for trouble.

examples.japanese: {災厄|さいやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧。
⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{災厄|さいやく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祈|いの}った→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.english: People prayed to protect themselves from disaster.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人類|じんるい}→人類：01578_jinrui⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{災厄|さいやく}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: War is said to be the greatest calamity for humankind.

notes:
A compound of {災|さい} (disaster) + ⟦{厄|やく}→厄：11989_yaku⟧ (misfortune/evil). A literary word that conveys a grave, almost fateful quality. Often used in written and formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {災厄|さいやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧: to be struck by calamity
- {災厄|さいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧: to escape disaster
- {災厄|さいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to ward off calamity
- {災厄|さいやく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect from disaster

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧: disaster — the standard term for natural disasters (earthquake, flood, etc.)
- ⟦{厄災|やくさい}→厄災：24387_yakusai⟧: calamity — nearly synonymous; reversed character order
- ⟦{惨事|さんじ}→惨事：28385_sanji⟧: terrible event, tragedy — emphasizes the horrifying nature
- ⟦{天災|てんさい}→天災：29302_tensai⟧: natural disaster — specifically disasters of natural origin
